lead: Shantanu Naidu was an entrepreneur, born on 28 December 1937 in Mumbai.
He died on 9 October 2024 in Mumbai at the age of 86.
He has been recognised with Knight Grand Cross of the Order of the British Empire and Maharashtra Bhushan Award.
The sections that follow break down Shantanu Naidu's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Shantanu Naidu — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shantanu Naidu was born on 28 December 1937 in Mumbai, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Naval Tata and his mother, Soonoo Tata. He is a sibling of Noel Tata.
He studied at Harvard Business School, Cornell University College of Architecture, Art, and Planning, Riverdale Country School and Campion School, Mumbai.
He is recorded as speaking Tamil and English.

sections.heading: Shantanu Naidu — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists entrepreneur, engineer, businessperson and philanthropist as his occupations, including work with IBM.
